The latest portrait

Richard Plant

Writer, Richard Plant, was instrumental in getting info about this history to the world. He wrote "The Pink Triangle: The Nazi War Against Homosexuals" and showed a history that was denied .

Read their story →
The project

Portraits to remember. Stories to keep alive.

Pink Triangle Portraits is an ongoing art and research project by Bry Sharland, honoring queer people persecuted by the Nazi regime.

Learn about the project →
